title: Queenstown vs Wanaka for Families — Which Should You Choose?
meta_desc: Queenstown vs Wanaka for families: compare costs, activities, and vibe to decide which NZ town suits your family best
intro: If you're planning a family trip to the South Island, you're likely weighing up Queenstown and Wanaka as your base. With similar stunning scenery, both towns offer a range of activities, but they differ significantly in cost, atmosphere, and suitability for families. Here's a honest comparison to help you decide.

sections.heading: Cost Comparison
sections.body: Accommodation is a significant factor when deciding between Queenstown and Wanaka. A family room in Queenstown can cost upwards of $250 per night, whereas in Wanaka, you can find similar options for around $180 per night. Additionally, food prices in Queenstown tend to be higher, with a meal at a mid-range restaurant costing around $25 per person, compared to $18 per person in Wanaka.

sections.heading: Activities for Families
list: Skiing and snowboarding at Coronet Peak ($120 per person per day) or Cardrona Alpine Resort ($130 per person per day)
Hiking the Ben Lomond Track (free) or the Rob Roy Track ($10 per person)
Visiting the Skyline Gondola ($40 per person return) or the Wanaka Tree ($0, free)
Taking a scenic flight over Milford Sound ($195 per person)

sections.heading: Vibe and Atmosphere
sections.body: Queenstown has a more vibrant, party-oriented atmosphere, with a range of bars, clubs, and restaurants. Wanaka, on the other hand, is more laid-back and family-friendly, with a stronger community feel. If you're looking for a relaxing, low-key holiday, Wanaka might be the better choice.

sections.heading: Driving Between Queenstown and Wanaka
sections.body: The drive between Queenstown and Wanaka takes approximately 1 hour, depending on traffic and road conditions. If you're planning to visit both towns, consider staying in one and taking a day trip to the other. Petrol prices are around $2.20 per liter, so a return trip would cost around $20-$30, depending on your vehicle's fuel efficiency.

sections.heading: Plan Your Trip with Our Tools
Choose Your Accommodation Wisely
sections.body: When choosing your accommodation, consider the location, price, and amenities. You can find a range of options in both Queenstown and Wanaka, from budget-friendly motels to luxury apartments. Be sure to book in advance, especially during peak season, to avoid high prices and limited availability.
